query:
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = 'Linalyl acetate' THEN 65.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Linalool' THEN 15.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Sclareol' THEN 5.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Germacrene D' THEN 3.0
  END,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = 'Linalyl acetate' THEN 'Composant majeur, note florale'
    WHEN m.name = 'Linalool' THEN 'Note herbacée douce'
    WHEN m.name = 'Sclareol' THEN 'Fixateur naturel, note ambrée'
    WHEN m.name = 'Germacrene D' THEN 'Note boisée de fond'
  END
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name = 'Sauge sclarée' 
AND m.name IN ('Linalyl acetate', 'Linalool', 'Sclareol', 'Germacrene D');
